Using the cutoff price of 82.50 EGP per share (given in the prompt), the price‑to‑earnings (P/E) ratio is approximately 82.50 / 6.98 ≈ 11.8, which is modest for a company with such large net profit and total equity of 157,708,140,765 EGP as of 31 Dec 2025 (evidence_id TMGH‑TMGH_FY2025_consolidated_en‑p5‑67).
